newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff off after Barron's report.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff off after Barron's report.

text.p: Shares of AccuStaff Inc fell 7/8 to 23-1/8 on Monday after Barrons's newspaper reported that the temporary staffing company has suffered a temporary cash drain.

Referring to footnotes included in the company's 10K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the paper's "Up and Down Wall Street" column, noting that the company had completed nine first-quarter mergers, said the drain was caused by funding the accounts receivable of some of its new acquisitions.
The company has drawn down a little more than 50 percent of its available revolving credit, the paper reported.
The article also questioned the company's rate of internal growth.
Company officials were not immediately available.
One analyst, Judith Scott of Robert Baird, contended that the article was "not justified." Scott said the company is in a "very strong financial position."
